---
description: "Use when changing the Direct3D 12 renderer, OldUnreal 227 adapter, texture upload, presentation, viewport, or renderer configuration code."
name: "D3D12 renderer guidelines"
applyTo: "D3D12Drv/**/*.{h,cpp}"
---
# D3D12 renderer guidelines

- Follow the inherited UT99VulkanDrv C++ style: tabs, `guard`/`unguard` where
  surrounding methods use them, and minimal comments focused on non-obvious
  engine behavior.
- Put `#if defined(UNREAL_227)` first in SDK compatibility branch ladders.
- Prefer a narrow 227 adapter over an unrelated upstream refactor.
- Preserve 227 render-device ABI requirements, including the
  `DrawGouraudPolyList` override and plain `URenderDevice` base.
- Keep logical viewport size separate from physical presentation size in
  borderless mode.
- Preserve viewport callback ownership: forward existing behavior, restore the
  original callback only when the renderer's wrapper is still installed, and
  delete only renderer-owned state.
- Treat texture-format branches, lightmap conversion, and realtime texture
  invalidation as host-sensitive code. Validate representative runtime content
  after changing them.
- Build the CMake target after every renderer edit. Run the relevant manual
  checks from `docs/testing.md` for presentation, input, or rendering changes.
- Update `docs/renderer-227k.md` and `docs/progress.md` when compatibility
  behavior changes.
